Figure 1:(a) User representation learning pipeline. Once trained on user behavioral sequences, a representation model can support various downstream applications, including text-based retrieval for user targeting, U2U retrieval for recommendation system and classification for advertising and risk control scenarios.
In industrial settings with billion-scale users, when scaling up input data volume, commonly via increasing behavioral timespan and user amount, models directly consume raw data (e.g., raw user behavioral text description), will suffer from performance saturation beyond practical scaling thresholds while tokenization will alleviate the limitation and enable sustained performance gains, as shown in (b).
